slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about truck capacity or the maximum number of containers per truck. It only asked about route restrictions/capacities in a vague way and did not target the truck capacity limit.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No truck capacity constraint applies; the model ignores the fact that each truck can carry up to 2 containers.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the truck capacity limit and did not include it in the final model structure, effectively assuming it is irrelevant or absent.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is P2, which does not affect the core optimization problem or objective value. The agent resolved the key demand and supply interpretations before stopping.

summary: The agent clarified the main supply and demand semantics but missed the low-impact truck capacity detail. Overall, the interaction was efficient and sufficient for the core transportation model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
